meta.title: Bandwidth ECG — A minimal macOS menu bar network monitor
meta.description: A minimal network speed monitor that lives in your menu bar. Track bandwidth peaks and daily usage, and let real data tell you whether you need a faster plan.

hero.titleZh: No more network anxiety — let the data speak.
hero.subtitle: A minimal speed monitor that lives in your menu bar. Track bandwidth peaks and daily usage accurately, stop guessing, and let objective data decide whether you really need to upgrade your plan.

features.sectionSubtitle: No fiddly setup, no distractions. Built for macOS, giving you only the core numbers you actually need.

items.title: Real-time rhythm
items.subtitle: Menu-bar readout
items.description: Up/down speeds sampled at 1 Hz and shown live in the menu bar. No window required.

items.title: Peak capture
items.subtitle: Daily & all-time
items.description: Automatically logs daily and all-time peak throughput so you can tell if your plan still has headroom.

items.title: Rhythm strips
items.subtitle: 1m → 24h windows
items.description: Nine time windows, from 1 minute to 24 hours, to see both micro-spikes and long-term shape.

items.title: Approach alert
items.subtitle: Amber / Red
items.description: As usage approaches your plan ceiling, readings turn Amber, then Red — just like a patient monitor.

items.title: Local chart
items.subtitle: No cloud storage
items.description: Every reading stays on your Mac. No accounts, no uploads, and the app collects no analytics.

items.title: Low-draw instrument
items.subtitle: Native and lightweight
items.description: Built on native APIs. You'll forget it's running — which is the point of a good monitor.

howItWorks.sectionTitleZh: From install to running, in one smooth go
howItWorks.sectionSubtitle: Three simple steps and you'll know exactly how your network is doing.

steps.label: GET THE APP
steps.title: Get the app
steps.description: Get the app and open it. It lives in the menu bar — no Dock clutter.

steps.label: CALIBRATION
steps.title: Enter your plan's ceiling
steps.description: Tell it your plan's rated speed (say, 500 Mbps) so the instrument knows when to raise an alert.

steps.label: DIAGNOSIS
steps.title: Live diagnostic readout
steps.description: From then on, every glance is a check-up. Upgrade decisions become data-driven — not vibes.

chartDemo.sectionTitleZh: Trend charts you can read at a glance
chartDemo.sectionSubtitle: Steady everyday use, sudden bursts of traffic — every detail of your connection shows up clearly in the chart.

faq.sectionSubtitle: Everything about Bandwidth ECG, right here.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Pricing and availability will be announced at launch. Either way: no ads, no account required.

items.question: Does my data leave my computer?
items.answer: No. Readings are stored only on your Mac — this is not a cloud service. To measure latency, the app sends a HEAD request to apple.com every 30 seconds by default (you can turn this off in Settings). It contains none of your readings.

items.question: Which macOS versions work?
items.answer: macOS 14.0 (Sonoma) and later. Apple Silicon and Intel are both native.

items.question: Will it slow down my Mac?
items.answer: It won't. Native and lightweight, it lives in the menu bar and stays out of your way.

items.question: How do I fully uninstall?
items.answer: Drop the app in the Trash. To clear all recorded readings too, also remove ~/Library/Containers/com.bobo52310.BandwidthECG.

download.sectionTitleZh: Let the data settle your plan.
download.sectionSubtitle: Local and lightweight. Decide with data, not gut feel.
